decision: The deeper 2026-08-24 pass found no single modern-designed artwork that simultaneously shows a living four-legged horse under skull/rib/long-bone barding, readable tack, one mounted living feral warrior, painted skull helmet, visible sling, visible stone pouch, and no spear/lance/sword substitute. The unit remains blocked rather than accepting an undead horse, riderless armor sheet, generic cavalry, spear-bearing substitute, or composite.
